about: A convention is told in one thread ("remember this"); a new thread needs it. Checks that a memory note was written and the new thread applied it.
prompt: A rule for this project from now on, please remember it for future sessions: every new IPC channel must also get a line in docs/ipc.md, in the form - `<channel>`: <what it does>. Nothing to change right now.

then.prompt: Add a new IPC channel `app:ping` in the main process (src/main/index.ts) that returns the string "pong", and expose it in the preload (src/preload/index.ts) as `ping()`.
